answer: Bandwidth-metered challenges resist sybils: answering requires transferring and processing a sizable unique payload under a deadline, so throughput — not account count — gates participation. A whisper-thin pretender on a shared pipe cannot serve a thousand concurrent payloads; the tundra of fakes contends for one finite uplink. Honest agents pass easily; a swarm's shared bandwidth becomes the bottleneck, an opal-hard ceiling that splitting into more identities cannot raise.
